name: 3.3 Numbers from states and effects
description: Blank starter: plug basis states into basis effects and read off the numbers.

exercise.title: Numbers from states and effects
exercise.statement:
A state or effect labelled **0**, **1**, **+** or **−** is that basis vector, $|0\rangle$, $|1\rangle$, $|+\rangle$ or $|-\rangle$ (any other label is a symbol). Build three small diagrams, each a state wired into an effect: $\langle 0|0\rangle$, $\langle 1|0\rangle$ and $\langle +|0\rangle$ (use ＋ New in the Diagram Editor's bar for each).

Read each number in the Dirac Formula Editor (Generate) and in the Numbers panel.
exercise.done: You have the three numbers, and you can say which one PQP would call *impossible* (§3.4.2) and why.
